description: Phase 2 (core logic in LoopCore) of .omc/plans/music-loop-game-plan.md §6. Gates G1-G8 in §2. No UI (Phase 3).

userStories.title: Song model: Codable + schemaVersion + validation
acceptanceCriteria: LoopCore/Sources/LoopCore/Song.swift: Song(schemaVersion, bpm, key, progression, tracks, sections) and LoopTrack(role drums/bass/chords/melody, timbre, bars, notes as Note in ticks); Codable
JSON round-trip test: encode -> decode -> equal, and a fixed JSON literal with schemaVersion 1 decodes (format lock)
Validation rejects: >8 tracks, BPM outside 60...160, bars not in {1,2,4,8}, notes outside the track's loop length; accepts valid songs (tests for each)
Unknown future schemaVersion is reported as an error, not a crash (test)

userStories.title: Timing: follow-along judgement with offset calibration

criterionAmendments.original: Applying the offset shifts judgement (test: constant 80 ms late input passes after calibration, fails before)
criterionAmendments.replacement: Applying the offset shifts judgement (test: constant 120 ms late input passes after calibration, fails before)
criterionAmendments.reason: 80 ms is inside the Good window (<= 100 ms), so an 80 ms late input already passes before calibration; the original criterion could not distinguish calibrated from uncalibrated
criterionAmendments.evidence: Plan §5: Good = |d| <= 100 ms and 80 < 100. TimingTests uses 120 ms: fails before calibration, all Perfect after (swift test --filter TimingTests: 7 passed)

acceptanceCriteria: LoopCore/Sources/LoopCore/Timing.swift: judge(expected notes, input hits(ms, pad/pitch), bpm, userOffsetMs) -> per-note Perfect (|d| <= 50 ms) / Good (<= 100 ms) / Miss, wrong pad or pitch = Miss, each input matches at most one note and each note at most one input
passed = (Perfect+Good)/expected >= 0.70 (boundary tests at 0.69/0.70 and 50/51 ms, 100/101 ms)
Offset calibration from stage 1 taps (median of deltas) clamped to +-150 ms; values beyond are clamped (tests at 149/150/151 and negative)
Applying the offset shifts judgement (test: constant 120 ms late input passes after calibration, fails before)

userStories.title: Arranger: auto intro/main/outro >= 60 s with per-section edits
acceptanceCriteria: LoopCore/Sources/LoopCore/Arranger.swift: arrange(song) -> sections: intro (drums+bass among tracks) -> main (all tracks, repeated) -> outro (remove one track per section until one left); repeat count chosen so total duration >= 60 s at the song BPM and longest loop length

Tests at BPM 60, 110, 160 and with 1, 2, 4, 8 tracks: total >= 60 s, every section length is a whole multiple of the longest loop, intro/outro composition as specified; songs without drums or bass fall back to first available tracks (test)
Section track toggle (AC9): setting a track on/off in a section changes only that section; arrangement stays valid (test)
Arrangement total frame length computed via Clock equals expected (test, no audio)

userStories.title: Stages: stages.json (G5 table) + build-task predicates
acceptanceCriteria: LoopCore/Sources/LoopCore/Resources/stages.json encodes the 18 stages of plan §5 (name, follow-along pattern notes, BPM, build-task predicate id + params); entry in licenses.json (license self); LicenseTests pass
Stages.swift loads all 18 in order with BPMs as in §5 (test checks every stage's BPM and name)
Each of the 18 build-task predicates has a passing and a failing Song fixture in tests
Pitched follow-along patterns are G3-valid (C major scale; strong-beat notes chord tones) — checked with Metrics in a test
Free creation is not gated by stage progress: no API locks it (G5 decision 'free creation open from start')
